Test Objective: Verify access rights are periodically reviewed
Test Procedure: Review quarterly access review and verify exceptions were remediated

Test Objective: Verify authentication controls are appropriately implemented
Test Procedure: Verify MFA password policy lockout session timeout and authentication logging

Test Objective: Verify vulnerabilities are remediated and retested
Test Procedure: Review vulnerability remediation and confirm post-remediation testing

Test Objective: Verify backups can be restored successfully
Test Procedure: Review backup restoration test results and recovery evidence

Test Objective: Verify security incidents are detected investigated and documented
Test Procedure: Review simulated incident record and response actions

Control Name: Information Security Awareness Education and Training
Test Objective: Verify personnel complete security awareness training
Test Procedure: Review training completion records and coverage

Control Name: Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets
Test Objective: Verify assets are identified and maintained
Test Procedure: Review asset register and ownership information

Test Objective: Verify privileged access is authorized and appropriate
Test Procedure: Review privileged access approvals and permissions

Control Name: Security Testing in Development and Acceptance
Test Objective: Verify applications undergo security testing before release
Verify security-relevant events are logged and monitored
Test Procedure: Review centralized logging configuration and monitoring evidence
